description: Servo-operated toggle assembly with a three-part printed rocker or a guided fork, identified purchased units and separately fabricated mounting components.
releaseRequirements: Confirm the delivered ST3215 12 V servo, supplied disc and retaining hardware, and the ASW-07D switch revision and keyed panel interface.
Measure switch operating force, actual pivot and trip positions; calibrate servo endpoints, speed and torque limits before allowing powered operation.
For the printed rocker, qualify PETG or PA grade, print orientation, support removal, layer strength, case retention, creep and rounded-finger wear.
For the guided fork, qualify TPU grade, printed pad orientation, stiffness, compression allowance, durability and replacement criteria from physical tests.
Assign material grades, stock blanks, manufacturing routes, guide fits, rod retention, fastener engagement, tolerances and inspection criteria to every fabricated component.
Verify complete linkage travel, panel and case mounting stiffness, manual access and clearance, including both maintained switch positions and push/return stages.
